change: Comeback: a win from a quarter of your health or less pays a quarter more gold

mutations.name: a knight on 0 health marks a comeback
mutations.find: note(B){ const g=Game.s; if(B && g && g.hp>0 && g.hp <= g.maxHp*this.AT) B.low=true; return !!(B && B.low); },
mutations.replace: note(B){ const g=Game.s; if(B && g && g.hp <= g.maxHp*this.AT) B.low=true; return !!(B && B.low); },

mutations.name: a comeback marks at half health
mutations.find: note(B){ const g=Game.s; if(B && g && g.hp>0 && g.hp <= g.maxHp*this.AT) B.low=true; return !!(B && B.low); },
mutations.replace: note(B){ const g=Game.s; if(B && g && g.hp>0 && g.hp <= g.maxHp*0.5) B.low=true; return !!(B && B.low); },

mutations.name: a blow above a quarter clears the mark
mutations.find: note(B){ const g=Game.s; if(B && g && g.hp>0 && g.hp <= g.maxHp*this.AT) B.low=true; return !!(B && B.low); },
mutations.replace: note(B){ const g=Game.s; if(B && g) B.low = g.hp>0 && g.hp <= g.maxHp*this.AT; return !!(B && B.low); },

mutations.name: a comeback pays in every mode
a slam does not mark a comeback
a fight starts with the last one's comeback
a miss's blow does not mark a comeback
the card leaves the comeback out of the gold it counts
